note: Simulated software inventory for the demo hall, by row (one version per row and component; a per-node change comes from Squawk's feed once a patch window ends). Production imports this from fleet management (DCIM / Redfish / the scheduler's node facts) and flags drift.
install_faults_note: Simulated post-install checks that fail (fleet management's health check after a patch window, in production). fails = how many windows in a row fail; the next one passes. A rollback always restores the old version.

install_faults.symptom: After the reboot the GPU kernel module did not load (the driver build against the running kernel failed); the node never rejoined the pool.
The driver loads, but the post-install GPU check fails: an 8-GPU all-reduce test hangs on GPU 3.
